# capacity of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:capacityOf`](gmeow-capacityOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/capacityOf>

- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The location whose capacity is measured. Functional: a capacity measurement concerns exactly one location (constitutive of the measurement's identity).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Capacity`](../classes/gmeow-Capacity.md) -> [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single location a capacity measurement concerns; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid several locations per measurement (mint one per location).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:capacityOf`](gmeow-capacityOf.md); generic observation queries reach it via the [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) spine.
